newsitem.title: BRAZIL: GM asks US to drop Brazil car imports probe.
newsitem.headline: GM asks US to drop Brazil car imports probe.

text.p: General Motors Corp has asked the United States to halt an investigation launched in October into Brazil's car import rules, financial daily Gazeta Mercantil said.
In a report from Washington, the paper said GM wrote to the U.S. Trade Representative's office asking it to reconsider its actions against Brazil's auto import regime.

"We call on the White House's trade representative to consider carefully the potential negative impact on American exports and the global competitiveness of U.S. auto companies if Brazil's auto policy is challenged in the World Trade Organization," GM was quoted as saying in a letter to the trade representative.
The U.S. and other countries complained earlier this year that Brazil's 70 percent import tariff on cars manufactured by firms without a Brazilian base is unfair.
